THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 16.11.2023, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 BAIL APPL. NO. 9863 OF 2023 2  ORDER
This is an application for anticipatory bail.

2. Petitioner is the 2nd accused in Crime No.937/2023 of Mannar police station, Alappuzha district,
alleging commission of offences under Sections 498A, 354B, 294(b), 324 and 506 r/w. 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: The petitioner/2nd accused and the de facto complainant, who are husband and wife are living separately for the last eleven years.

The allegation which led to registration of Crime No.937/2023 of Mannar police station is that, on 22.10.2023, at about 06.00 pm, when the de facto complainant went to the house of the accused to meet her elder daughter (who is residing with the petitioner/2 nd accused), the 1st accused (who is the brother of the 2 nd accused) showered obscene words on her and beat her with an iron rod and also tore her dress.
It is alleged that the 2 nd accused also attempted to attack her with an iron rod, which was prevented by the mother of the accused.
It is further alleged that the 1st accused had attempted to stab her and thereby, the accused committed the offences alleged against him.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that the allegations are absolutely false.
It is submitted that the petitioner and the de facto complainant are living separately for the last eleven years though their marriage was not dissolved.
The allegations are raised only to settle other matrimonial disputes between the petitioner and the de facto complainant.
It is submitted that no serious injuries are reported by the de facto complainant.

It is submitted that even if the allegations are true, the allegation of attacking the de facto complainant and attempting to stab her are all against the 1 st accused and not against the petitioner herein.
5. Heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

6. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the opinion that anticipatory bail can be granted to the petitioner subject to strict conditions.
The allegations against the petitioner are as noticed above.

As rightly pointed out by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the allegations of attack and an attempt to stab the de facto complainant are against the 1 st accused who is the brother of the petitioner.
There is a specific allegation that when the petitioner/ 2 nd accused tried to attack her using an iron rod, same was prevented by the mother of the accused.

Taking into consideration the overall facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the opinion that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary for completing the investigation into the crime registered against him.
In the result, this application is allowed.
(iv) The petitioner shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the investigating officer in Crime No.937/2023 of Mannar police station may file an application before the jurisdictional court, for cancellation of bail.

It is made clear that the observations in this order are only for the purposes of considering the entitlement of the petitioner to bail and shall not be treated as a finding by this Court on any aspect of the matter.
It is also made clear that this order will not entitle the 1 st accused to seek bail on similar terms.
